name: Eventbrite event discovery homepage by eventbrite.com
description: The page opens with a full-bleed concert photo hero whose headline sits on pink-to-purple highlight blocks, with a small pink eyebrow badge and a single white pill CTA — playful but tightly cropped. Below, rhythm shifts from airy (a white rail of outlined category circles) to functional: a location dropdown and underlined filter tabs feed a 4-column event grid where photos, overlay heart/share icons, urgency badges and blue price links carry all the weight while headings stay small. Down the page imagery fades out deliberately: a scrollable destination photo carousel, then three text-only pill-link clusters ('Popular cities', 'Explore by State', nearby cities) that get denser and cheaper to render, before a deep purple 4-column footer. Colour is disciplined: orange only for the logo and search button, blue only for links and active tabs, letting photos provide the vibrancy.
